ozet: Bir deneyimi sırayla anlatmayı (first, then, after that) ve “Have you ever …?” sorularını öğreneceğiz.

satirlar.metin: First, we took the train to London.
After that, we had dinner in a Turkish restaurant.
satirlar.tr: Ondan sonra bir Türk restoranında akşam yemeği yedik.

satirlar.metin: In the end, we got home very late.

bolumler.govde:
Hayatında hiç … yaptın mı? ***Have you ever** been to Scotland?* Cevap: *Yes, I have. I went there last year.* / *No, I've **never** been there.*

Ayrıntı verirken geçmiş zamana geç: *I **went** there last year.*

satirlar.metin: Have you ever been to Scotland?
Yes, I have. I went there last summer.

bolumler.soru: Görevli “Tell me about a nice day you had recently.” diyor.
cozum: Sırayla anlat: first, then, after that.
Bir duygu ekle: It was lovely.
bolumler.sonuc: ***Last Sunday we went to the seaside. First we walked on the beach, then we had fish and chips. It was a lovely day.***

bolumler.govde: “Have you ever been …?” sorusuna ayrıntı verirken yine present perfect kullanmak: “Yes, I have been there last year.” Belirli zamanla geçmiş zaman gelir: **I went there last year.**

options: Have you ever go to London?
Have you ever been to London?
I have been there last year.
